arStrings.szText: {c_important}Quill Volley{/c} makes enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}. If they are already {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}, Quill Volley deals {c_number}[{SF_12} * 100|%|]{/c} more damage.

{c_important}Quill Volley{/c} hurls out {c_number}{SF_19}{/c} additional {if:SF_36}claws{else}feathers{/if}. Consume {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} Nearby {c_important}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/c} to shoot out {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} more.
{c_important}Quill Volley{/c} costs {c_number}[SF_10*100|%|]{/c} more Vigor and the {if:SF_36}claws{else}feathers{/if} return after reaching their Max distance.
{c_important}Quill Volley{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_33} * 100|%|]{/c} increased damage when Cast within {c_number}{SF_35}{/c} seconds of {c_important}Evading{/c}.
{c_important}Quill Volley's{/c} feathers explode at their apex, dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_EXPLODE}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Quill Volley's{/c} feathers fly {c_number}[{SF_15} * 100|%|]{/c} further and converge on your target, dealing {c_number}[{SF_21} * 100|x%|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Damage.

{c_important}Quill Volley{/c} is now a {c_important}Jaguar{/c} skill that deals Fire damage and costs {c_number}[SF_13]{/c} less Vigor. 

{c_important}Quill Volley{/c} sends out {c_number}{SF_29}{/c} piercing claws that deal {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_UPGRADE_C}{/c} damage twice.
